Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott

Class PhoneController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott.PhoneController
All Implemented Interfaces:
PhoneApi
@RestController public class PhoneController extends Object implements PhoneApi
Shows, enrols, verifies and removes the phone number of the authenticated account, the number the SMS codes go to. The paths, status codes and bodies are those of the contract apis/auth-server/rest-server/ auth-server-api-v1.yaml, through the generated PhoneApi; failures are answered by OttExceptionHandler. Starting an enrolment and verifying it spend SMS budget and guess a code, so both are limited per client address and per account (OttRateLimiter). Starting an enrolment (which may replace the verified phone, a second factor) and removing the phone need a recent multi-factor sign-in while the account has a confirmed second factor (StepUpGuard).
